business_type: cyclical grower (custom AI silicon and data-center connectivity)
moat_source: custom-ASIC design relationships and SerDes/optics IP; evidence: $1.5B custom revenue growing 20%+ and 28% total growth - but Marvell is structurally the second source in a market Broadcom leads

returns.assumption_note: Convergence to scenario IV by year 5, ~60% of the gap closed by year 3.

sensitivity_key_driver: custom XPU design-win trajectory (share of the non-Broadcom custom market)
primary_model_risk: Second-source economics: the bull case requires Marvell to win Broadcom-scale custom programs at Broadcom-like margins; historically the number-two custom vendor wins smaller programs at thinner margins. If FY2027's ~40% growth proves to be the cycle peak rather than the ramp's beginning, the base case's deceleration is optimistic.
expectations_gap_key_variable: the Broadcom-jackpot probability: at ~79x trailing (and ~2x our expected IV even after the July 7 drop) the market prices Marvell as the next AVGO; our base case prices it as a strong second source - the entire gap is that one word
top_5_bull_arguments: Record revenue +28% y/y with FY2027 guided to ~40% growth on exceptional AI bookings
Custom XPU pipeline is real: $1.5B FY2026 custom revenue growing 20%+, with hyperscalers wanting a second source to check Broadcom
Full-stack connectivity portfolio (optics + switching + XPU-attach) rides every AI data-center build regardless of whose accelerator wins
S&P 500 inclusion completed - a permanent widening of the shareholder base
Bull case (~$234) roughly equals today's price - if the jackpot narrative is right, the downside is time, not capital
top_5_bear_arguments: Expected IV ($126) is ~46% below the price; ~79x trailing earnings for the market's SECOND custom-silicon source
Broadcom takes the biggest programs first; Marvell's custom wins are structurally smaller and thinner-margin
The July 7 unwind (-8%) showed how much of the +130% run was index mechanics and momentum, not fundamentals
Weekly price prints conflict (-8.49% vs -22.11%) - a disorderly, crowded tape
AI-capex digestion hits all three product lines at once; there is no defensive segment
thesis_breakers: A flagship custom XPU program cancellation or loss to Broadcom
Q2 FY2027 actuals below $2.57B (bottom of guide)
Custom chip revenue growth stalling below 10% y/y
Optics share loss to Coherent/Lumentum in 1.6T qualifications
position_size_recommendation: 0% at current price; revisit near expected IV (~$126) or on a confirmed multi-billion-dollar custom win that rebases the revenue trajectory
notes_on_nulls: ROIC/ROE/ROA null: not captured as sourced ratios. Revenue/guidance/custom-revenue figures are reported or management-stated; FCF path is calibrated from non-GAAP margin structure - confidence_level medium. Weekly change conflicted across sources (-8.49% used in pass1; -22.11% printed elsewhere).
historical_context: Directional context only - low confidence.
